_comment: TEMPLATE for deploy/seed-paths.local.json — copy it, fill in this machine's paths,
and leave the copy out of git (.gitignore already covers it).
WHAT THIS IS FOR. A system's first deploy into ~/deploy/<system> starts with an empty
tree for anything gitignored: accumulated watcher state, caches, local data. This file
says where, ON THIS MACHINE, a first deploy may COPY that state from — normally the
developer clone the system used to run out of. The copy happens once; every later
deploy and every rollback leaves the state alone, because a tag checkout does not touch
WHY IT IS NOT IN THE CONTRACT. The system's deploy/deploy.json is tracked in the
system's own repo and has to be true on every machine that ever deploys it. An
absolute path to one person's home directory is not that. Putting it there — or in the
federation's tracked registry.json — would be a per-machine fact stored at one shared
path, which is WI-0132's defect. So the contract names the path INSIDE the tree, and
this file names where it comes from OUTSIDE it.
Keys under a system are the contract's `state[].path` values, verbatim. A path with no
entry here is not an error: the runner says so and leaves the system to create its own.
The runner NEVER moves and NEVER overwrites — the source keeps its copy as a fallback.
